simple: Threat intelligence from TrendAI Research and the Zero Day Initiative: threat actor and campaign profiles, strategic reports, ready-made threat-hunting queries and a continuously updated feed of indicators of compromise delivered to your security tools via API. Licensed per platform account (Threat Intelligence Hub). Part of the TrendAI Vision One platform (Trend Micro’s business unit, formerly Trend Vision One); licensed with TrendAI Flex credits that can be reallocated across platform solutions.
